sloka: उत्पाट्य वा ते हृदयं भक्षयिष्यामि मैथिलि ।यदि मे व्याहृतं वाक्यं न यथावत्करिष्यसि ।। ५.२२.३२।।।।
transliteration: utpāṭya vā te hṛdayaṁ bhakṣayiṣyāmi maithili ।yadi me vyāhṛtaṁ vākyaṁ na yathāvatkariṣyasi ।। 5.22.32।।।।

translations.english: King Ravana, a tormentor of enemies, having thus threatened Mythili commanded the shedemons women of fiecrceful appearance as follows:
